historical_implementation.status_reason: All automatable M14 work and checks passed on post-review code, across all three checkpoints (M14-A labels/review, M14-B sampling/preferences/splits, M14-C export/readiness/profile), recorded in one coherent handoff. Store schema v10 (additive). Correction learning: three producers (explicit teach incl. with collection off, M08 certified edit windows, single-dictation note edits); the S29.7 multi-axis classifier with honest abstention, contraction-aware negation and case gates, stage attribution under the retained stage texts; rule suggestions only for ASR-origin recognition errors; approval composes with M05 entries (created/alias_added/alias_approved/already_present), runs counterexamples in the rule's own scope, records its plan before any vocabulary write so undo reverses exactly what it did; rejection permanent. Versioned labels, source-anchored partial grafts and a shared ASR promotion gate; labels and teach refuse non-live evidence. Sampling: seeded 10% stream + explicit/hard/supplemental/late-trigger strata, one inclusion per example. Same-task pair review (A/B/tie/neither/uncertain; latest judgment wins). Versioned family splits with a 10-family floor and permanent forward-only exposure. Portable export (five task views, streamed hash-verified audio, consistent snapshot, finalize recheck, never replaces a user's folder) and a hardened offline validator. Your Voice: eligible-evidence measured views (quarantine, snippets, background and repeated speech excluded), cards citing their own evidence, snapshots as records cleared on deletion/expiry, chunked reads, unchanged-evidence idle skip, no injection. Deletion and expiry propagate to job-keyed and note-sourced candidates; rows carry offsets not words. The /review-2 -> /address loop found 3 criticals (deletion/retention propagation, content in rows plus a job-pinning lease, label resurrection of quarantined evidence) and 20 further findings - all addressed with regression tests (one decided by measurement: the export snapshot stays one op per S29.13). Suites: 62/62 green on the final code incl. every model-backed suite and the V1 control 51/51. Benchmark at 10k examples: worst dictation write wait 54 ms during profile compute, 1 ms during mining, 50.3 ms during export; export 715 MB/s with audio adding 0.3 MB peak memory; the idle profile pass decides from counters alone (p95 38 ms). Live store left at v9 to migrate with its automatic backup on the next dev run. Live data is below every floor (6 examples, 0 observations, 0 labels, 0 pairs) - the valid measured-only state. Pending: the native M14 trial; 16 human checks open overall.
